pkgmetadata.longdescription:
pmxcfs — the Proxmox cluster filesystem FUSE daemon. Provides /etc/pve/ as a distributed, corosync-backed, SQLite-persisted configuration filesystem. Also builds IPCC.so (Perl XS IPC bridge to pmxcfs via libqb) and installs PVE::Cluster, PVE::IPCC, PVE::Cluster::IPCConst.
Source: upstream proxmox.com pve-cluster 9.1.6 (newer and more secure than pxvirt 9.0.6 — see docs/packages/pve-cluster-moddoc.md). One pxvirt patch applied: /cluster/vmlist UUID endpoint.
Single-node operation: pmxcfs runs in local mode without corosync. See pkg_postinst() for bootstrap instructions.
